AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-31-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of Two Minors.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Maureen Howard.
Petitioner: Ronald Sanders, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Mario Polk and Marie Polk, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Morgan Freedom Sanders and Mariah Lisa Sanders.
Decree signed in open court.

AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-29-2005 Reset To Jan-31-06 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of Two Minors.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Leticia Perez.
Petitioner: Ronald Sanders, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Mario Polk and Marie Polk, was sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minors' Mother consent or proof of service on notice, the OSC for Change of Name of the Minors is continued to Jan. 31, 2006 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to submit proof of service to the Minors' mother of the new hearing date or an Order dispensing with notice.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.

AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-04-2005 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of two Minors.
Dept. 218, Judge John Conway, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Janet Pond.
Petitioner: Ronald Sanders, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Mario Polk and Marie Polk, was sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minor's Mother consent and defective proof of service of notice, the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor is taken off calendar for Petitioner to file the Declaration and Order Dispensing Notice and to set a new OSC hearing date.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing, no further publication needed.
